## A second 2.8" build, for the other half of these boards

The 2.8" CYD ships with one of two different display controllers depending on manufacturing batch -- ST7789 or the older ILI9341 -- same glass, same pinout, no way to tell which from the outside. Flash the wrong one and you get a solid white screen, not a helpful error. Up to now this project only built for ST7789; there's now a second build for ILI9341, and the web flasher's board picker (now a dropdown, since there are three options instead of two) has a standing note -- and Squachy says it too, the first time you switch -- telling you to just try the other 2.8" option if you land on a white screen.

Also in this release: runtime serial speed bumped from 115200 to 2,000,000 baud on boards confirmed to hold it cleanly (the CYD's CH340-family chip does; AWOK's CP210x doesn't, so it stays on a safe fallback instead of guessing).

### The actually-useful part
- **Added**: a second 2.8" CYD build for boards with an ILI9341 panel instead of ST7789 -- pick it from the web flasher's dropdown if the other variant gave you a white screen
- **Changed**: web flasher's board picker is now a dropdown with a standing white-screen note (and a Squachy line) instead of two buttons with no guidance
- **Changed**: runtime serial speed raised to 2,000,000 baud on hardware confirmed to hold it cleanly, with a safe fallback for chips that don't
